newsitem.title: USA: Pacific Sunwear to open 50 new stores this year.
newsitem.headline: Pacific Sunwear to open 50 new stores this year.

text.p: Pacific Sunwear of California Inc., a mall-based retailer of youth casual apparel, said Friday it plans to open 50 new stores this year and 60 next year.
The Anaheim, Calif.-based company had previously announced plans to open 40 new stores in 1997.
Based on these plans, the company said, it expects to operate about 260 stores at the end of 1997 and 320 stores at the end of 1998. It currently has 216 stores in 33 states.
The company also said in 1998 it will expand or relocate 10 to 15 stores in existing malls to the larger format to accommodate the addition of junior merchandise and footwear.
Pacific Sunwear's stock rose $1.25 to $29.75 on Nasdaq in late morning trading.
